name: Justin Riddle
abstract_title: Hierarchical Brain Architecture as a Mechanism for Entity Encounters in Altered States
abstract: Entity encounters are a widely reported feature of certain psychedelic states, including those induced by N,N-dimethyltryptamine (DMT), ayahuasca, ibogaine, and high-dose psilocybin, but they also arise in non-pharmacological contexts such as advanced meditation practices (e.g., Fire Kasina) and trance-based active imagination. Their recurrence across diverse induction methods suggests that entity encounters represent a core dimension of mystical experience that warrants rigorous scientific inve
authors: Justin Riddle, Maria Fini, Paul Seli, Jonathan Schooler
field: Cognitive control, brain stimulation, hierarchical consciousness
notable: Developed the Nested Observer Windows (NOW) model; PhD from UC Berkeley with Mark D'Esposito
notes: PI of the Riddle Lab studying neural basis of cognitive control.
